formulas.occupancy: A planet contributes its disclosed attention weight to the sign it occupies at 12:00 UTC on the first day.
formulas.eventProximity: event multiplier = 1 - 0.25 × elapsed horizon fraction; the multiplier therefore runs from 1.00 to 0.75.
formulas.ingress: attention = (10 + half the planet occupancy weight) × event multiplier; tone = 0.
formulas.otherEvents: attention, tone, and volatility = disclosed event weight × event multiplier for every directly named sign.
formulas.totals: Sign totals are rounded sums, with attention and volatility clamped to 0–100 and tone clamped to −100–100.
formulas.market: Liquidity depth compares a sign with the collection median; turnover is 24h volume ÷ indexed liquidity. Neither alters the sky signal.

evaluation.baseline: Compare with persistence and equal-sign baselines on a held-out period.
evaluation.priceMetric: Direction accuracy and magnitude error after fees/slippage.
evaluation.liquidityMetric: Direction accuracy and absolute percentage error for indexed USD liquidity.
evaluation.publicationRule: Publish every signal before its outcome window; do not rewrite misses.

marketSnapshot.separationRule: Market fields are descriptive and never alter the symbolic sky scores.
